'''Rad-dampening shielding''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] that protected against the harmful effects of radiation. The [[Garbage scow/Legends|Trade Federation scow]] ''[[Spotty Conveyor]]'', which transported radioactive waste from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Federation]] industrial [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planetoid [[PDC3141-02]], possessed this kind of shielding. However, during a dumping run to PDC3141-02 in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the scow's rad-dampening shielding began to fail after the ''Conveyor'' was prevented from depositing its cargo on the planetoid.
